deploy.startCommand: sh -lc 'case "$SHARKEDGE_SERVICE_MODE" in odds-worker) SHARKEDGE_WORKER_MODE=railway ALLOW_RAILWAY_HEAVY_WORKER=true npm run worker:odds-refresh ;; sim-worker) SHARKEDGE_WORKER_MODE=railway ALLOW_RAILWAY_HEAVY_WORKER=true npm run worker:railway:sim ;; mlb-odds-worker) SHARKEDGE_WORKER_MODE=railway ALLOW_RAILWAY_HEAVY_WORKER=true npm run worker:railway:mlb-odds ;; ufc-worker) SHARKEDGE_WORKER_MODE=railway ALLOW_RAILWAY_HEAVY_WORKER=true npm run worker:railway:ufc ;; maintenance-worker) SHARKEDGE_WORKER_MODE=railway ALLOW_RAILWAY_HEAVY_WORKER=true npm run worker:railway:maintenance ;; *) npx prisma migrate deploy && npm run start -- -p ${PORT:-3000} ;; esac'
